episodes.title: One Box Left
episodes.description: The hunters corner the Count in his London house. He doesn't stay cornered.

scenes.narration: Jonathan's knife rips the Count's coat open, and gold pours across the floor.
scenes.visual: Gold coins spilling from a slashed black coat onto floorboards, a curved knife flashing

scenes.narration: The hunters had been waiting for him in his house in Piccadilly.
scenes.visual: Men waiting in a dark Victorian room, weapons ready

scenes.narration: All day, they'd destroyed box after box across London.
scenes.visual: Men in a horse-drawn cab racing through foggy London streets

scenes.narration: And Mina now carries a red scar where the holy bread touched her forehead.
scenes.visual: A red burn mark on Mina's forehead, her eyes closed in pain

scenes.narration: When the Count walked in, they were ready.
scenes.visual: The Count stepping through a doorway, eyes narrowing

scenes.narration: Jonathan swings his great curved knife.
scenes.visual: Jonathan swinging a curved knife at the cloaked Count

scenes.narration: The Count leaps straight through the window.
scenes.visual: The Count leaping through a window in a burst of glass

scenes.narration: From the courtyard he sneers up at them. His revenge, he says, has only begun.
scenes.visual: The Count looking up from a courtyard, sneering

scenes.narration: They count the boxes.
scenes.visual: The hunters searching a cellar with lanterns, crates smashed open

scenes.narration: One is missing. In Part 17, Mina finds a way to track him.
scenes.visual: A single wooden crate on a dark London dock

episodes.title: Through His Eyes
episodes.description: Mina turns the Count's curse into a weapon.

scenes.narration: Mina closes her eyes, and she can see what the Count sees.
scenes.visual: Mina in a trance, eyes glazed, faint red light around her

scenes.narration: His bite linked their minds. Now she wants to use it against him.
scenes.visual: Mina sitting upright, determined, the red scar on her forehead

scenes.narration: At dawn, Van Helsing hypnotises her.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing hypnotising Mina by candlelight, moving his hands before her eyes

scenes.narration: Darkness. Water lapping. Chains creaking.
scenes.visual: Darkness inside a ship's hold, water dripping, heavy chains swaying

scenes.narration: He's on a ship.
scenes.visual: A sailing ship gliding down a river at dawn

scenes.narration: The Count is running home to his castle.
scenes.visual: A huge dark castle on a cliff under storm clouds

scenes.narration: The ship is the Czarina Catherine, bound for the Black Sea.
scenes.visual: An old map of Europe with a route traced to the Black Sea

scenes.narration: The hunters pack their weapons for one last journey.
scenes.visual: Weapons, crucifixes and travel cases on a table by lamplight

scenes.narration: If the Count dies, Mina's curse dies with him.
scenes.visual: Mina touching the scar on her forehead, looking out at the dawn

scenes.narration: But the link works both ways. In Part 18, he starts reading them.
scenes.visual: The Count's shadowy face looming in darkness, eyes glowing

episodes.title: One Step Ahead
episodes.description: The hunters chase the Count across Europe, but he always seems to know their next move.

scenes.narration: Every move they make, the Count already knows.
scenes.visual: The Count's shadowy face looming over Mina as she sleeps

scenes.narration: The hunters race across Europe by train to meet his ship.
scenes.visual: A steam train racing through Eastern European countryside

scenes.narration: They wait at the port for days.
scenes.visual: Men waiting on a misty harbour quay

scenes.narration: The ship never comes. It docks somewhere else, in secret.
scenes.visual: A ship docking at a river port at night

scenes.narration: By the time they get there, his box is gone, carried up the river.
scenes.visual: An empty dock with drag marks where a crate was taken, a river beyond

scenes.narration: The hunters split up.
scenes.visual: The group separating at a muddy crossroads

scenes.narration: Jonathan and Arthur chase him by steam launch.
scenes.visual: Two men on a small steam launch racing up a wide river

scenes.narration: Seward and Quincey ride hard along the banks.
scenes.visual: Two riders galloping along a riverbank

scenes.narration: Van Helsing takes Mina straight to the castle.
scenes.visual: A carriage driving through the snowy Carpathian mountains

scenes.narration: But Mina is changing. She sleeps all day now. In Part 19, the sisters come for her.
scenes.visual: Mina asleep in a carriage, very pale

episodes.title: The Circle in the Snow
episodes.description: Three vampire women rise out of the snow, calling Mina their sister.

scenes.narration: Three women rise out of the snow, calling Mina their sister.
scenes.visual: Three pale women forming out of swirling snow at night, arms reaching

scenes.narration: Van Helsing has made camp below the Count's castle.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing and Mina at a campfire in snowy mountains, a castle in the distance

scenes.narration: Around Mina, he has drawn a circle of holy bread.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing scattering white crumbs in a circle around Mina in the snow

scenes.narration: The women beckon. Come, sister. Come to us.
scenes.visual: Three pale women beckoning with outstretched arms, smiling

scenes.narration: Mina can't leave the circle. And they can't come in.
scenes.visual: Mina inside a faintly glowing circle in the snow, the women outside it

scenes.narration: At dawn, Van Helsing walks into the castle alone.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing walking through a ruined castle gate at sunrise

scenes.narration: He finds the three women asleep in their tombs.
scenes.visual: Three stone tombs in a dark chapel, pale faces visible inside

scenes.narration: And ends them. One by one.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing standing over a stone tomb in a dark chapel, hammer in hand

scenes.narration: Then he seals the Count's empty tomb.
scenes.visual: A large empty stone tomb being sealed in a dark chapel

scenes.narration: Far below, a wagon with one box races for the castle. Part 20 is the final battle.
scenes.visual: A horse wagon racing up a snowy mountain road carrying a large crate

episodes.title: Sunset
episodes.description: If the sun sets before they reach the box, the Count wakes up. The final part.

scenes.narration: If the sun sets before they reach that box, the Count wakes up.
scenes.visual: A red sun sinking behind snowy peaks, a wagon racing below

scenes.narration: The hunters charge the wagon from every side.
scenes.visual: Riders galloping through snow toward a wagon surrounded by men

scenes.narration: Jonathan and Quincey fight their way to the box.
scenes.visual: Jonathan and Quincey forcing their way through a crowd of men around a wagon

scenes.narration: Quincey is wounded. He doesn't stop.
scenes.visual: Quincey clutching his side, blood on his coat, still pushing forward

scenes.narration: They tear off the lid.
scenes.visual: Hands tearing the lid off a wooden box in the snow

scenes.narration: The Count's red eyes open, in triumph.
scenes.visual: The Count lying in a box of earth, red eyes snapping open in the sunset glow

scenes.narration: Jonathan's knife slashes his throat. Quincey's blade drives into his heart.
scenes.visual: Two blades striking down into a box, silhouetted against the setting sun

scenes.narration: The Count crumbles to dust, with a look of peace.
scenes.visual: A figure crumbling into dust that drifts away in red sunset light

scenes.narration: The scar fades from Mina's forehead.
scenes.visual: Mina's clear forehead, tears of joy, golden sunset light

scenes.narration: Quincey dies smiling. He knows they've won.
scenes.visual: Quincey lying in the snow smiling, friends kneeling around him

scenes.narration: Years later, Jonathan and Mina name their son Quincey.
scenes.visual: Jonathan and Mina with a small boy in a sunny English garden
